flavor.phonemic_palette: germanic (norse register: konungr/jarl, dithematic -r/-son names, ai>ei and i/u-umlaut, w- lost before round vowels, the axe-bearing hird and the sea-keel) / classical (hellenic: the polis and the agora, the archon/basileus civic register, pitch-accent learning, -os/-on/-polis toponyms, the philosophers and the fleets)

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore): Lawful venerates the Lawful powers and names the Chaotic as demons; Chaotic the reverse; Neutral honors ancestral and local powers, invoking the great powers situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Hellmark — domineering martial aristocracy of the synthesis; conquest, honor, valor.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Hellmark are a warlike martial aristocracy people, a first-order synthesis of Hellaspol and Thiodmark [Conquest Aristocracy (thiodmark over hellaspol)]. They prize conquest, honor, valor, lean toward the military sphere, and field heavy_infantry, light_infantry, marines. Outsiders are met as domineering; their patrons touch war.
